item.tib: ga rgya'i sman gzhung) 'di'i dbu'i mtshan byang yod sar shog gcig ma tshangs
item.coloph: ces gso rig rgyud 'bum bye ba'i yaMng snying 'gro kun 'byung 'khrugs nad kyi zug rngus gdung ba kun sel sman sbyor stong rtsa phan bde bde skyid kyi dga' ston rol pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba 'di nyid ji ltar sbyar ba'i tshul ni rnam rgyal gzungs chen las gso rig gi bon sde gsum ni/ gso bya'i nad 'bum nag po/ 'tsho byed dpyad 'bum khra bo/ rnam rgyal sman 'bum dkar po gsum ste 'ol gling du gtan la phabs nas/ dpyad bu khri shes la gtad/ ces gsungs pa yang / phyis bsam yas dbu rtse nas ban de mi gsum gyis gter nas bton cing lha rje g.yu thog pas zhus pa'i 'bum gsum dang*/ gdal 'bum sogs las bshad pa'i sman rgyud brgya phrag gcig dang*/ yongs grags rgyud bzhi 'di yang phyis bI ros bsgyar ba dang*/ g.yu thog pas mdzad pa dang gter nas bton pa sogs bshad kyang*/ don du tres sam dang cur nis sogs zhang skad mang du 'byung bas 'gyur khungs gang yin des ston pas gzhan du smon ci dgos/ gzhan yang zhang zhung 'khor lo rgyal po'i dpe bum sogs zhang zhung nas 'gyur ba'i sman rgyud dang / dngul chu grub pa'i bstan bcos sogs rgya gar nas 'gyur ba'i bka' brten dang / sman dpyad zla ba'i rgyal po sogs rgya nag nas 'gyur rigs dang*/ bdud rtsi bum chen bum chung snang gsal shel bum sogs rnying ma'i skor dang / bi dza'i po ti kha ser/ brang ti'i lag len che chung / phyis su bod du gso rig la mkhas pa'i byang pa rnam rgyal grags bzang / mi yi nyi ma/ lhun sdengs rnam rgyal rdo rje/ bstan 'dzin rgyal po/ zur mkhar ba blo gros rgyal po/ mnyam nyid rdo rje/ mi dbang sA ra/ del dmar bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ kong sprul yon rgyam/ mi pham 'jam dpal rgyas pa sogs gso rig phyogs la bka' drin che zhing / gzhan yang rang gzhan mkhas grub du mas rgyud lung khungs ldan nas nyams myong gis gces btus rigs sogs mang yang de dag phal cher bcos kyi dbu mjug las mtha' yongs rdzogs dben cing 'thor bu song gshis nad rnams gting 'don byed pa'i bcos kun ma tshang bas bya thabs dka' zhing / de phyir dbu mjug gnad kun tshang ba'i lag len pod chung zhig brtsom na legs 'dug snyam pa'i skabs su/ smon rgyal nam mkha' grags pa nyid kyis rang re bon gyi ring lugs rig gnas sogs bstan pa gong spel mdzad dgos zhes bka' gsung spyi phebs dang / gzhan yang rang sde gzhan sde'i mkhas btsun du mas smon sbyor gces btus gnad zab cig dgos zhes yang yang bskul bar brten/ gong gi rgyud lung man ngag kun gyi gzhir dbub/ gsang sngags rigs sngags skor nas bsrung ba sngags bcos zab rgu'i rigs rnams zur rgyan cing*/ sngon 'gro nad rigs so so'i slong rkyen na lugs goms pa rtsa chu brtag pa nas dngos gzhi thang phye ril bu lde gu sman mar sogs nas mtha' gcod dpyad kyi las mtha' gang dgos bar le'u re re'i khong du tshang bar byas te mkhas rmongs bar gsum kun gyi bde blag tu rtogs sla ba'i ched du khyon sdom sbyar thabs stong dang rtsa brgyad kyi grangs ang gtso bor bkod kyang sman sna gcig gnyis gsum bzhi sogs phar cher sbyar thabs stong rtsa'i grangs khungs ma gtogs par brgya phrag du mar yod nges dang*/ zur bkol gces btus 'chi bdag zhags gcod kyi nang du'ang gong dang mi 'dra ba'i sbyar thabs brgya phrag lhag thal bkod pa dang / bzo thabs pa tra'i 'phrul 'khor nang rin chen thal bzo dang sman gyi dug phral skor/ zur rgyan nyer mkho ru rtsa chu'i brtag tshul nus pa rkyang sel sngo sman 'khrungs dpe gtar me'i lag len bcas le'u bzhi yi nang du gso dpyad kun gyi gnad kun snying po ma tshang bar med par bsdus te bkod pa'i glegs bam 'di nyid du man ngag lag len gang la gang dgos kyi bcos kun gzhan bltos mi dgos par 'di rang gcig pus sger thub chog par byed pa po gshen gyi drang srong 'tsho byed 'jigs med nam mkha'i rdo rje'am/ g.yung drung rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por 'bod pas 'o skol ston pa rnam 'dren chen po gzugs sku'i dkyil 'khor ngoms pa'i 'byung ldan dang po nas da lta sum rgya'i nang tshan sa byi nas bzung sa mo glang gi lor zla ba dang po'i tshes bco lnga gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge legs phun sum 'tshogs pa'i nyin mjug yongs su grub par bgyis pa'i rnam dges 'gro khams lus can nyon 'khrul nad gdung thams cad las grol te sangs rgyas sman bla'i go 'phang mchog chen la 'god pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
